title: Add MealPlanFiles Regression Tests
description: Add or extend CookbookAppTests coverage for MealPlanFiles read/write helper signature behavior and bracketing-balance invariant using temporary file fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Tests write and read meal-plan markdown through the new folderURL-aware helper signatures.
Tests verify callers do not need to pre-bracket the folder URL for simulator happy-path IO.
Tests include a focused invariant for balanced access start/stop behavior where feasible in the existing test architecture.
Tests do not claim to reproduce the on-device entitlement-loss failure mode.

handoff_summary.completed: Updated existing round-trip and nil-read tests to the new `readText(from:folderURL:)` and `writeText(_:to:folderURL:)` signatures. Added `writeTextCreatesFileAtExpectedURL`, `callerDoesNotNeedToPreBracketFolderURL`, `discoverFindsFileWrittenViaWriteText`, and `bracketingBalanceOnSimulatorURL` tests covering all four acceptance criteria.
handoff_summary.risks: None. Changes are confined to the test file; no production code was altered.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent to run the full CookbookAppTests suite and confirm all MealPlanFilesTests pass.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — only test file modified, no overlap with other in-flight beads.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Followed the ShoppingListFilesTests pattern exactly, adapting for .menu extension (5 chars), plans/ subfolder, and plansURL(in:) function name. Existing tests updated in-place rather than removed to preserve coverage of discover/displayName/plansURL helpers.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: All four acceptance criteria covered: folderURL-aware round-trip I/O, no-pre-bracket caller invariant, nested bracket resolution via discoverFindsFileWrittenViaWriteText, and balanced-bracketing simulator invariant. On-device entitlement-loss explicitly not claimed to be reproduced.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Bracketing balance test verifies only the simulator happy path (startAccessingSecurityScopedResource returns false for temp URLs). On-device behavior with real security-scoped bookmarks is untestable in the simulator environment.

conflict_risks: None — only test file modified, no overlap with other in-flight beads.
